nominal_identifiers.invariant: Ident kind stores nonempty text with a kernel-checked proof; namespaces cannot coerce to String or to each other. Unknown optional roles, checker constraints and authored revisions use Option Ident, not empty valid IDs.

T01.meaning: Successful whole-KB decoding and structural admission imply global wellFormed (unique identities, exact bindings, references, finite witnesses, supersession-cycle rejection).
T01.assumptions: Strict versioned object transport; raw parseKB is structural parsing only, not admission.

T02.meaning: Encoding/decoding and decode-first canonicalization preserve bounded states, recursive witnesses, contexts, admission/selection plans and journals, authored workflows/gates/investigations, and every bidirectional typed result codec.
T02.assumptions: Concrete syntactic field validity and constructor depth <=256, never assumed decoder success. Internal witness completeness is unbounded finite. Raw request/trusted-environment framing and output-only retrieval have no typed codec pair; their validation is exercised by conformance rather than an invented roundtrip theorem.

T03.meaning: Applied publication preserves globally well-formed candidate state; retained selection preserves every current ledger collection.
T03.assumptions: Authenticated environment supplies full-plan capabilities bound to exact base Context/policy/source selections. Adapter authenticates snapshot history and rejects reused historical publication identities; kernel selection also rejects retained identity reuse. Durable atomicity is an adapter refinement obligation.

T04.meaning: Structural recursive checker acceptance implies independent inductive Derives, and every finite Derives witness is accepted; public checker and admitted derivation preserve exact conclusion scope/formula/polarity.
T04.assumptions: No external PremisesHold. No world-truth assumption needed for derivability.

T05.meaning: Every enabled inference preserves compositional interpretation; admitted exact conclusions hold under local proposition-specific evidence soundness.
T05.assumptions: EvidenceSound applies ONLY actual exact selected atomic or inventory-certificate attestation leaves. Inventory truth is equality with independently interpreted domain(source,revision,query,scope,method), not supplied-members definitional truth. False atoms and nonempty-domain countermodels are inhabited.

T06.meaning: Matching every actual computed transitive dependency transfers derivability at the same explicit context/time.
T06.assumptions: FootprintMatches compares actual target lookups, including full discovery records and empty correction selections; context/time fixed.

T07.meaning: Changes outside a successful computed witness footprint preserve its exact checked result; independent query-local agreement also preserves all checker outcomes.
T07.assumptions: Receipt/usability additionally recompute root corrections, contrary evidence and policy rather than assuming witness locality covers global assessment.

T08.meaning: Missing or mismatching actual accepted dependency footprint prevents receipt reuse for that alternative.
T08.assumptions: Freshness is recomputed origin recency, not a cache-validity flag; receipt reuse and mandatory policy gates remain separate.

T09.meaning: Any surviving accepted exact-revision alternative preserves selected support; policy blockers remain separate.
T09.assumptions: Own polarity is exact requested Ref; opposite atomic evidence remains independently visible.

T10.meaning: Removing all accepted alternatives removes support; no arbitrary unsupported atomic proposition follows in an inhabited false interpretation.
T10.assumptions: No negation-as-failure rule; independent negative support requires its own evidence.

T11.meaning: Fixed-input expired recency cannot be restored by increasing time; inclusive endpoints and future timestamps are explicit.
T11.assumptions: Fixed observation time/TTL; new observations or validations are separate inputs.

T12.meaning: Every recursive witness constructor preserves exact selected originating observations and their timestamps/source/revision/content; arbitrarily deep child dependencies are retained and scope cannot widen.
T12.assumptions: Origin integrity is structural and independent of external source truth; no inference mints observation time.

T13.meaning: All and absence require recursively derived exact inventory completeness certificates in addition to actual retained acquisition and every member proof; missing certificate or members rejects. Independent-domain semantics prevents forged empty inventory from proving absence under sound local evidence.
T13.assumptions: Exact source/revision/query/scope/method finite-domain completeness is an explicit inventory proposition attested by named evidence. Local certificate soundness is external, not a blanket completeness flag. Source selection must match pinned Context.sources.

T14.meaning: Arbitrary unsupported atoms cannot be derived by reverse navigation or composition; false atomic interpretations exist.
T14.assumptions: Only six explicit typed constructors are inference rules; navigation edges are not witness constructors.

T15.meaning: Pinned immutable historical selection survives appended later snapshots; forward active selection retains current corrections and does not alter witness support or evidence age.
T15.assumptions: Historical release identity is distinct from current selection; adapters retain and authenticate native objects.

T16.meaning: Pure supersession append leaves support unchanged, cannot increase admitted validation/reuse, and cannot use a source receipt to validate a distinct replacement revision.
T16.assumptions: Validation monotonicity requires the actual old-state wellFormed receipt-dependency invariant and a fresh appended correction; a retained executable raw-state counterexample shows why that admission invariant matters.

T17.meaning: Usability entails applicability and every mandatory selected freshness, validation and uncontested condition.
T17.assumptions: Selected claim polarity determines support/freshness; four-valued report does not erase contrary evidence.

T18.meaning: Factual transitions use exact current receipts; authored verified transitions require current definition/target-bound gate evidence and landed references; publication requires authenticated full-plan approval and rejects self-issued capabilities.
T18.assumptions: Authored parser/gate/landed resolution facts come from actual adapters, never supplied pass/resolves booleans; release approval is independently signature authenticated. Exact signed Context binds full selected policy, source selections, target/use and versions. Authored lifecycle alone is not release authority.

T19.meaning: Structural investigation completion requires nonblank examined-input/scope text and no open or malformed typed hypotheses.
T19.assumptions: Empty hypothesis list and unk are valid; factual admission is separate. Parser classification is covered by production tests.

T20.meaning: Applied publication/selection requires expected predecessor; rejected or replayed publication preserves state/journal; selection references exactly the trusted retained target.
T20.assumptions: Conditional durable publication remains adapter refinement; pure model never weakens immutable-prefix admission.

T21.meaning: Actual applied result plus produced journal composes with same-input replay unchanged; changed full inputs conflict, and selection uses the same journal construction.
T21.assumptions: Canonical identity is entire typed plan, not caller-provided digest. Journal newest-first.

T22.meaning: Evaluation has the same result for identical explicit model inputs; no clock/random/IO or implicit HEAD in core.
T22.assumptions: Lists are explicit ordered inputs. Retrieval pagination pins snapshot and preserves selected ordering; no database-row permutation theorem is asserted.

note: Kernel status is reported separately by proof_check.py. T01-T22 meanings and trust boundaries above are the bounded semantic contracts, not a claim that cryptographic provenance, remote storage, parser classification or durable publication is kernel verified. Standard logical axiom allowlist: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
